item.title: Sam Darnold faces Panthers, looks to lead Seahawks closer to NFC West title
item.description: QB Sam Darnold. The Seahawks have five straight wins with Darnold under center. Next up for Darnold is one of his former teams, the Carolina Panthers, who allowed him to leave in free agency following two seasons in Charlotte in 2021-22. Darnold revived his career last year in Minnesota, and has built on that success this season in Seattle. Seattle can clinch the NFC West this weekend with win and a Rams loss or tie against the Falcons as well as a 49ers loss or tie against the Bears.
